$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

scopes.description: Subset of resolution scopes the host implements. `workspace` is the RFC 0048 sub-tenant; `tenant` and `user` align with the `secrets.scopes` vocabulary.

encryptionAtRest.description: Host encrypts stored credential material at rest.

rotation.description: `two-key-overlap`: old + new credential both resolve as valid during a grace window, then the old fails with `credential_not_found` (mirrors `openwop-auth-api-key-rotation`). `none`: no rotation surface.

sharing.description: A single stored credential can be referenced by many workflows within a scope (e.g. a workspace-shared key) without copying material between references.
